name: Pluxee NV
summary: Pluxee N.V. specializes in delivering a comprehensive suite of employee benefits and engagement solutions to businesses across France, Latin America, Continental Europe, and other international regions. Their diverse offerings include essential employee advantages such as meal, food, gift, mobility, training, and wellness programs. The company further addresses aspects like mental and physical well-being, cultural and leisure access, support for hybrid work arrangements, and uniforms. Additionally, Pluxee N.V. provides reward and recognition initiatives, public sector benefits, and robust fuel and fleet management services. These solutions are conveniently distributed through prepaid cards, advanced digital platforms, and traditional paper vouchers. Founded in 2022, the company operated as Sodexo Asset Management 2 B.V. before officially adopting the name Pluxee N.V. in December 2023. Its corporate headquarters are located in Issy-les-Moulineaux, France.
